        "All 12 owned paths and all 1093 historical diff lines were read. No changed test paths are present. Go clones the stream, adopts a replacement when needed, obtains the folder ID/client and starts remote creation. Existing focused lessons 892044f… and 7b77d1e… cover those exact accepted boundaries and are reused.",

Accepted code later separates failure/null-header guards and marks sent file copies read locally; those later changes are not part of this original landing.
